title: Alteon Targets Year-Long Flight With Wind-Harvesting Autonomous Aircraft
dek: Backed by Lachy Groom, Indian startup Alteon is developing autonomous aircraft designed to use wind energy to remain airborne for months, potentially up to a year.
socialCaption: Indian startup Alteon, backed by Lachy Groom, is developing autonomous aircraft designed to harvest wind energy and stay airborne for months. Its stated ambition: flight endurance of up to a year. The next signal to watch is demonstrated time aloft.
